Use case: precise-object-edit.
Input image 1 is the approved Native icon and is the EDIT TARGET. Create its matching LIGHT appearance.
Keep the exact same interlocking folded-diamond emblem, every contour, gap, line thickness, location, proportions, tile size, rounded corners and transparent margins.
Change ONLY the colors: the rounded-square tile becomes a pale cool porcelain gray (#F0F1F3), and the emblem becomes a very dark graphite (#202226). Keep everything flat, beautifully crisp and calm. No new details, letters, outlines, lighting or material effects. The result should be a faithful colorway of the same icon. Genuine transparency outside the tile.

Use case: precise-object-edit.
Input image 1 is the EDIT TARGET: the current Native app icon.
The user likes the refinement, palette, stroke weight and dark background, but the six-petal rosette resembles Factory too closely.
Change ONLY the white central emblem. Preserve the dark rounded-square tile, its dimensions and placement, transparent outer margins, the flat monochrome treatment, the off-white color, the line weight and the generous spacing.

Replace the radial flower with a distinctive compact folded-loop emblem whose overall silhouette is a softly angular diamond, slightly wider than tall. Imagine one continuous broad outline bent into two offset rounded rhombus loops that interlock once at the center, with one precise black break at the crossing to show the over-under connection. Two beautiful open diamond-shaped negative spaces, balanced diagonally. Elegant geometry with flowing corners, neither sharp polygonal nor inflated. The emblem feels like an abstract precision joint or a beautifully folded path. It is one unified graceful emblem. Carefully balanced geometry, strong distinctive silhouette at small sizes.

Make it recognizably different from the input's floral/radial shape. No petals, no circular rosette, no radial spokes, no star, no atom, no letter or type. No extra elements. No gradients, glow, metallic materials, textures, 3D, bevels, shadows, or decorative effects. Keep the confident flat app-icon graphic quality of the input. One centered icon, genuine transparency outside the tile.

status: Archived image-generation explorations. These prompts document the design process, not the final PNG exports.

final_assets.note: Original is the compiled native AppIcon.icon asset and follows macOS Default, Dark, Clear and Tinted appearances. Other themes are Dock image overrides with light/dark artwork. Glass PNGs and Glass.icon remain archived design explorations.

channel_assets.renderer: Apple Icon Composer ictool, layered SVG sources
channel_assets.availability: October 1 through November 7, inclusive, in the local Gregorian calendar; optional seasonal Dock overrides restore the selected base icon afterwards.
channel_assets.halloween_design: Haunted interlock: the Native folds become two ghosts with cut-out eyes and flowing tails. Pumpkin orange for Regular, spectral green for Beta, moonlit lavender and a harvest moon for Nightly. The ghost folds use native gradient shading, edge light, fabric creases and floating sparks. Nightly has 14 bright four-point stars and 22 smaller stars, all high contrast in both appearances. Editable SVG layers and Apple Icon Composer rendering.
channel_assets.development_design: Cyan and chalk interlock on a slate blueprint grid, with registration corners and code chevrons. Debug builds select the compiled AppIconDev asset. The Halloween development edition keeps the blueprint and uses the haunted folds. Both have light/dark renders; the compiled Dev icon also supports native Clear and Tinted appearances.
